Binds the write destination directly to the supplied collection_name, with only a default when it is absent.
Shows the branch taken when a collection name is supplied and how owned-file content is prepared for that destination.
Shows the configuration branch that returns without performing a vector-database write.
Shows the call that passes the caller-supplied destination, documents, add mode, and user into the vector-database save helper.
Shows successful persistence metadata and the response reporting the selected collection.
The request form accepts a caller-supplied collection_name alongside the source file_id.
The pre-write query checks duplicate hashes and file IDs, without performing a collection write-access check.
For an existing collection, add mode proceeds past the existing-collection branch; only overwrite and add=False receive special handling.
Constructed document items are inserted into the supplied collection_name and the operation returns success.
This helper enforces collection access for a specified access_type by rejecting denied collections.
